# Lotte Maxild Mortensen

Lotte Maxild Mortensen is an epidemiologist affiliated with Afdeling 3 at RKKP's Videncenter and a member of the steering group for the Danish ADHD database [^src1]. She is mentioned once in the corpus, listed alongside other steering group members — overlæger, speciallæger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, and pårørenderepræsentanter from across Denmark [^src1]. No further biographical or relational details are available in the source material.

The ADHD database she helps oversee monitors the quality of assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and adolescents under 18 in Denmark, including statistical data on the population diagnosed or treated between 1 April 2023 and 31 March 2024, and findings such as lower rates of passing the folkeskole's leaving exam before age 17 among children with ADHD compared to the background population [^src1].
